## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` pass
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` passes (required when routes, rendering, SEO or navigation change)
- [ ] User-facing text added in both `en.json` and `pt-BR.json`
- [ ] Career content matches LinkedIn (no invented facts or metrics)
- [ ] No secrets, private data or new dependencies without a stated reason
- [ ] Checked the Vercel preview in both languages, with no console errors
